document.title: Focus ranges and lettered line notes inside hunks
document.summary: Groups gain `focus` ranges and up to three `notes`. `validate` checks them against live hunks, `refresh` carries them, `show` prints line numbers, and the group view opens a focused hunk on its range with lettered note pins.
document.why: [#163](source:s1) brings excerpts and lettered, line-anchored notes to Comprehende, anchored so live git still wins.

sources.title: Focus ranges and line notes inside hunks
sources.gist: Per-group focus ranges and notes, loud validate checks, a collapsed hunk view, refresh rules per hunk status, and numbered show output.

sources.label: PR #170
sources.gist: Implements #163 on main, with decisions for review.

lookFor: [#163](source:s1) says only `changed` names the group in the refresh report. Head also drops `reformat` anchors and anchors that land on context a `same` hunk no longer shows, and counts both with the `changed` ones.

groups.title: Focus and note fields
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) asks for `focus` and `notes` on each group. The later groups read these fields.
groups.summary: `review.ts` adds `focus` and `notes` to the group schema, and `anchor.ts` holds the helpers that find the hunk holding an anchor.

attention.note: The 25-line cap, `end >= start`, and the three-note cap are zod checks in `review.ts`, so `serve` and `export` also refuse a document that breaks them. Only placement against live hunks waits for `validate`. Decide whether a bad range should block `serve`.

groups.title: validate and refresh
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) wants a range or note outside its hunk to fail loudly, and refresh to carry each one by hunk status.
groups.summary: `anchorErrors` in `anchors.ts` runs from `cmdValidate`, and `carryAnchors` runs inside `refreshDocument` to shift or drop each anchor.

attention.note: A `reformat` hunk drops its ranges and notes like a `changed` one, because whitespace edits can move lines inside the hunk. A whitespace-only push loses them, and the agent writes them again.

focus.caption: `shiftOf` moves an anchor by the hunk's first changed line, and drops it when the hunk changed or no longer holds it.

groups.title: Numbered show
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) asks `show` to print line numbers, so the agent copies them instead of counting from the `@@` header.
groups.summary: `numberedPatch` in `show.ts` numbers the raw hunk text, and `cmdShow` prints it for a file or a hunk.

groups.title: Collapsed hunk and note pins
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) asks a focused hunk to open on its range with one click to the whole hunk, and notes to show as lettered markers.
groups.summary: `focusPatch` in `focus.ts` cuts the file patch to the focused lines that `HunkView` renders under a `FocusBar`, and `PierreDiff` adds `NotePin` rows as line annotations.

attention.note: While any hunk of a file is cut, `HunkView` turns off hydration and `PierreDiff` shows `@@` headers between hunks instead of expandable gaps. A gap count would call hidden changed lines unmodified. "Show whole hunk" brings both back.

focus.caption: A change block cut at the range edge widens to the whole block only when the cut-off part holds the other side.

notes.body: Hydrating a cut patch would fill the hidden changed lines from the full file as plain context.

groups.title: Eval grading
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) asks for rubric lines for focus ranges and notes.
groups.summary: The grading packet lists each group's ranges and notes, the grader checks each caption and note at head, and three `expected.md` files gain rubric lines.

groups.title: Skill and glossary
groups.why: [#163](source:s1) asks the skill to say when to write a focus range or a note, and the glossary to define both.
groups.summary: A new Focus and notes section in `SKILL.md` names when to write each one, and `example.md` and the glossary show both.

groups.title: Synced copies and generated schema
groups.why: `pnpm sync:skill` and `pnpm generate:schema` write these files from the skill source and `review.ts`.
groups.summary: The `.agents` skill files copy `skills-next`, and the three `review.schema.json` files are generated from `review.ts`; the reader can skip them.

commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: Fix excerpt headers on an empty side, widen mid-block ranges, keep no-newline marks in show
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Review round 1: an all-insertion excerpt of a new file wrote a -1 start; a
range starting mid-block missed the deletions it replaces; an anchor on
context a same hunk shed survived refresh and failed validate; show lost
git's no-newline marker.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Focus ranges and line notes inside hunks
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Groups gain focus (a range inside one live hunk, at most 25 lines, with a
caption) and notes (line-anchored, at most 3). validate fails a range or
note outside its group's live hunks. refresh shifts them with a same hunk
and drops them with a changed or gone one. show prints old and new line
numbers. The UI opens a focused hunk on its range with a Show whole hunk
toggle and letters notes A, B, C as Pierre line annotations.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
